title: Identification and validation of aryl hydrocarbon receptor-associated hub genes in ulcerative colitis via integrated bioinformatics analysis.
authors: Zhao, Yuanpei; Wang, Jiaping; Min, Xiaoli; Jiang, Fuqiong; Shi, Kaiwen; Liu, Hongyuan; Hu, Yichen; Li, Wenliang; Li, Weiming
one_liner_zh: 该文通过生物信息学分析鉴定溃疡性结肠炎中AhR相关枢纽基因，但仅涉及基因表达与免疫浸润，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Ulcerative colitis (UC), a chronic inflammatory bowel disease, continues to pose substantial challenges in both diagnosis and treatment. The aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) plays a pivotal role in intestinal immune regulation; however, its core regulatory network in the progression of UC remains largely undefined. This study aims to identify core UC-related genes associated with AhR and to validate their expression in dextran sulfate sodium (DSS)-induced murine models, thereby elucidating potential mechanisms underlying UC progression. METHODS: Using the GSE75214 and GSE87466 datasets from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database, immune cell infiltration was quantified via the CIBERSORT algorithm. Candidate genes were identified through differential expression analysis, weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA) module selection, and construction of an AhR co-expression network. Gene Ontology (GO), Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG), and gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) were performed, followed by construction of a protein-protein interaction (PPI) network using STRING and application of two machine learning algorithms to identify AhR-associated hub genes. Finally, the expression of key genes was validated in DSS-induced UC mouse models using real-time quantitative real-time quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR). RESULTS: A total of nine AHR-related shared genes were identified, which were significantly enriched in immune response, amino acid metabolism, and oxidative stress pathways. Through integration of the PPI network and machine learning approaches, three central hub genes (PPARG, IL1B, and IDO1) were identified. Immune infiltration analysis revealed pronounced immune dysregulation during the progression of UC, which may contribute to disease development. Animal experiments confirmed the expression of these three key genes in colonic tissues, and hematoxylin-eosin (H&E) staining revealed extensive infiltration of inflammatory cells, consistent with the bioinformatics findings. CONCLUSION: PPARG, IL1B, and IDO1 were identified as potential key genes closely associated with AHR, suggesting their possible involvement in modulating AhR signaling in UC, thereby offering a theoretical basis for disease diagnosis and therapeutic strategies.
abstract_zh: 目的：溃疡性结肠炎（UC）作为一种慢性炎症性肠病，在诊断和治疗方面持续构成重大挑战。芳香烃受体（AhR）在肠道免疫调节中发挥关键作用；然而，其在UC进展中的核心调控网络仍 largely 未明确。本研究旨在识别与AhR相关的UC核心基因，并在葡聚糖硫酸钠（DSS）诱导的小鼠模型中验证其表达，从而阐明UC进展的潜在机制。方法：利用基因表达综合（GEO）数据库中的GSE75214和GSE87466数据集，通过CIBERSORT算法量化免疫细胞浸润。通过差异表达分析、加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）模块选择及构建AhR共表达网络，识别候选基因。进行基因本体论（GO）、京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）及基因集富集分析（GSEA），随后使用STRING构建蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络，并应用两种机器学习算法识别AhR相关核心基因。最后，在DSS诱导的UC小鼠模型中，通过实时定量聚合酶链反应（RT-qPCR）验证关键基因的表达。结果：共识别出九个AhR相关共享基因，这些基因显著富集于免疫应答、氨基酸代谢及氧化应激通路。通过整合PPI网络和机器学习方法，确定了三个核心枢纽基因（PPARG、IL1B和IDO1）。免疫浸润分析显示，UC进展过程中存在显著的免疫失调，这可能促进疾病发展。动物实验证实了这三个关键基因在结肠组织中的表达，且苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色显示大量炎症细胞浸润，与生物信息学结果一致。结论：PPARG、IL1B和IDO1被确定为与AHR密切相关的潜在关键基因，提示它们可能参与调节UC中的AhR信号传导，从而为疾病诊断和治疗策略提供理论基础。
